column1: # Polish name -> USDA FoodData Central fdcId mapping.
# Hand-curated, script-assisted. This file decides BOTH which USDA entries end up in the
# bundled nutrition subset AND what they are called in the Polish UI. `scripts/build-nutrition.mjs`
# joins it against the FDC Foundation + SR Legacy downloads and writes src/lib/nutrition/ingredients.json.
# Tab-separated, four columns; `#` starts a comment, blank lines are ignored.
#   fdcId  name (Polish)  aliases (| separated, may be empty)  state (raw|cooked, default raw)
# `state` follows the USDA entry, not the shopping basket: "cooked" means the per-100 g values
# describe the food after cooking. 300 g of raw rice is not 300 g of cooked rice, so both exist
# as separate rows wherever the difference matters.
# Keep rows sorted inside their section and never reuse an fdcId: it is the ingredient's identity
# (`usda:<fdcId>`) and planned meals reference it forever.
